oggetti.desc: Use this to display and organize crewmember cards during the Ship Facilities phase.

Per Section:
Rank I = Max. 4
Rank II = Max. 3
Rank III = Max. 2

Max. Crew = 36

oggetti.nome: Points of Interest (from Tutorial Deck A)

oggetti.desc: All cards from Tutorial Deck A & B are already set up on the table. Crewmembers still need to be placed in their starting positions. Once the tutorial is complete, don't forget that many Tutorial Cards should be REMOVED FROM THE GAME. (There's a box for this at the right.)

To keep all available Equipment cards organized and easy to review, place each Section's unlocked Equipment cards face-up on these dedicated boards to create an Armory for each Section. Use the bottom gray board for general Equipment that can be used by any Section.
To keep all available Gathered Discovery cards organized and easy to review, place them face-up on this dedicated board.

The small Section Compartment boxes above each section's deck contain infinity bags of the Sections Cards for Rank I, II, and III. Use these to build the section decks. Each section's dice & Individual Objectives are also stored in these section compartments when that section is not in use.

For future missions that include the lander, place the Lander Board from the box at the right onto this platform. There are snap points on the platform for the Lander Board, Equipment Cards, Rank-Up Card, and Discoveries.
For future missions that include Threats, move this platform into position at the top right of the Planetopedia. There is a snap point for precise placement.
For future missions that include Discoveries, move this platform into position at the top left of the Planetopedia. There is a snap point for precise placement.

Right-click on this board and change its State to choose a different page of the Planetopedia. The Planetopedia is very large in dimensions, so it was difficult to scan. I had to piece it together from multiple scans, and there are a few minor, visual flaws that should not affect the game.

Components that are "Removed from the Game" can be placed in the corresponding box to the left of this note. Don't simply delete Removed components, since you may want to reference them in the future.

I've added helper Notecards to assist with the use of this mod. After you've reviewed each notecard, feel free to delete them. Please let me know in this workshop mod's Discussion section if you find any issues or missing components! Thanks, and I hope you enjoy ISS Vanguard!
Cards in this area represent cards that would be stored in the game's White Box.
Cards in this area represent cards that would be stored in the game's Black Box.

The Planetary Scanner has two states that represent each side. When landing, place the Landing Card faceup underneath the Planetary Scanner. Then, right-click and change the Scanner to state 1, which will reveal the first cost. Move the Scanner down to reveal following costs.
Change to State 1 to flip over

stati.desc: Change to State 2 to flip over

oggetti.desc: The Add-On Facility will be added later during the campaign. Assets for the Add-On Facility are stored in the Secret Envelope, which can be found in the white box at the upper-left corner of the table. DO NOT OPEN THE SECRET ENVELOPE UNTIL INSTRUCTED TO DO SO BY THE GAME!

This rules summary from The Esoteric Order of Gamers is incredibly helpful! There is a copy on this side and the right side of the table. Click through the pages to find tons of helpful reminders, as well as full details on how to use the Ship Book! Rules for Ship Facilities are on the final page.
Look underneath the card dividers on top of each deck to find the cards they are concealing.
Click "Place" on the bag at the right to display and organize crewmember cards during the Ship Facilities phase.

Download your own PDF copy of the Logbook (and Rulebook) by visiting the ISS Vanguard website:

https://issvanguard.com/resources/

It will be easier to record progress in a downloaded PDF than in this object.

Cards typically have their number printed on the back. Sadly, it would be a huge effort to create custom card backs for 500+ cards. Therefore, card backs are generic, without numbers. However, each card is LABELLED WITH ITS CORRECT NUMBER and can be found by SEARCHING the deck.

Change the state of this object to cycle through the 22 pages in the System Maps book. Use the Current System Decal to mark the current system. 


Use the Checkmark Decal to mark completed objectives in the book.

Instead of using card sleeves, to mark a crewmember's assigned Section and current Rank, use the corresponding Decal to mark the crewmember's card. When they rank up or change Sections, replace the previous Decal with a new one.
Each section has its own dedicated dice tray for rolling dice. After dice have been spent, move them from this tray into the Spent Pool section to the right of each crewmember's section board.

Revealed Event cards can be placed on this platform below the Event deck. There is a snap point for precise placement. Don't forget to REMOVE the Tutorial Events Deck from the game once the tutorial is complete, and replace them with the standard 40-card Event Deck found to the left.

Don't forget to remove each section's tutorial Section Cards from the game once the tutorial is complete (there is a "Removed From Game" box at the top right). These cards are marked as "TUTORIAL CARD" in their Description, and they have no rank number (I, II, or III) next to their Section icon.

These can be purchased and permanently added to the sections by spending Success Tokens during the Debriefing phase, part 3) Buy or Sell Dice.
Press "1" over any die to reset it to its "Default" starting side for easy identification.

To remove a section from the table, click the Recall button on that section's bag. To return a section to the table, click the Place button. BE SURE TO STORE THAT SECTION'S CURRENT DICE (and Section Decks if you want) IN THE SECTION COMPARTMENT before Recalling it!
DO NOT OPEN THIS until instructed to do so by the game!

This box contains additional components that will be unlocked as the campaign progresses.

DO NOT OPEN THIS until instructed to do so by the game!

For the Tutorial, Amir begins with the Start Token. In future games, The Recon Section player chooses which Crewmember receives the Start Token. At the start of the each round, the Crewmember with the Start token
chooses any Crewmember (including themself) and gives it to them.

Instead of using the "2 Actions Left/1 Action Left" token to mark a Crewmember's remaining Actions, I've created simple counters for each Section that count between 2, 1, and 0 with – and + buttons. Click the word "Actions Left" at the bottom of the counter to reset it back to 2.

Once an entire row of Unique Discoveries is complete, the bonus at the far left of that row will be unlocked. For example, finding Unique Discoveries 1, 2, 3, & 4 will unlock card B11 (Hall of Trophies). Finding Unique Discoveries 17, 18, 19, & 20 will unlock card B15 (Armillary Spheres).

This galaxy map is printed on the back of the Logbook, and includes spaces for the players to record notes as they explore the various systems. I've included a copy here to serve the same purpose, feel free to use the Text & Draw Tools to add notes and markings.
Store Section Dice (and optionally Section Decks) in here when this Section is not in use.

These are to display the reverse side of the Veteran Crewmember cards from the Personnel Files expansion, which are in a grey box at the top left of the table.

All 90 Veteran Crewmember cards are now included.

This box contains Veteran Crewmember cards and abbreviated Rules from the Personnel Files expansion.

All 90 Veteran Crewmember cards are now included.

I don't recommend stashing your Gathered Disocveries underneath this card divider, since they will be hidden in a stack. Instead, in order to keep them organized and easy to review, place them face-up on the dedicated board at the far left side of the table.
If a piece of Equipment has a corresponding token, it can be found in this red bag.

For full details on how to use each page of the Ship Book, INCLUDING pages not seen here, follow the detailed instructions in the RULES SUMMARY doc at either side of the table. This doc covers all details of how to progress through each page of the Ship Book step-by-step.
Production Queue 2 is locked at the start of the game. Once Production Queue 2 has been unlocked (via a Production Upgrade card), delete the X tokens below.
Production Queue 2 requires a specific Ship Upgrade before it can be used.

When adding new cards to the Ship Book, move the label token out of the way, place the new card, then replace the label token. This represents slotting the card into a sleeve in the Ship Book. There are dedicated and different snap points for both ship cards and label tokens.
Content from the Personnel Files Expansion

Instead of using a downloaded copy of the Logbook, you can use the official ISS Vanguard companion app:
https://issvanguard.com/app/

Professional voice-overs with special effects and music! Automatic saves of your choices made in the campaign!

After exploring a planet, you may need to record its state in order to return. The game does this by you taking notes about the things in play. I recommend creating a dedicated save game called "(Planet) Explored". Load this game and copy (or Search & Spawn) the things you need to return.

The Possible Situations deck has 10 cards at the start of the game, labelled S01-S10. These cards are intended to be in sequential order, with card S01 being the first Situation that will be drawn. DO NOT SHUFFLE THIS DECK until the game instructs you to do so!

Feel free to unlock these platforms and move them around as needed, everything has snap points to stay neatly organized.
I also made a Round counter that we sometimes found useful, but it's not a standard or required component for the game.

Click the white button at the edge of the table below to open the Flex Table menu. Use the Tabletop Surface Image section to change the table's surface image. There are 2 generic "Felt" tabletops, and I've added 4 custom ISS Vanguard images as well. Take your pick or add your own!
